blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Consistent dark theme with CSS variables, uppercase panel labels, and light/dark toggle show design intentionality, but the network graph is unreadably dense at render size, the thumbnail grid is cramped, and the accent palette is uninspired — functional and coherent but not polished.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline correct, scaleSqrt used for all circle-size encodings (nodes and color scatter), data-driven domains throughout, but the network node scale resets domain to [0, maxFilteredCount] on each filter, violating the subset invariant by causing node sizes to jump when data is subsetted.
flags: Stale Scale (x/y scales captured in brush closures with no resize handler — stale after window resize)
Synchronous O(n) bitFilter.set() on every brush mousemove before RAF gate
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: Excellent RAF dirty-flag coalescing and no feedback loops, but missing a resize observer leaves brush scales permanently stale after layout changes.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: Four linked views with pre-computed (non-live) force layout, opacity-modulated single-hue network, and thumbnail gallery stay within working memory limits, though the 60-node network and dense thumbnail wall approach the threshold where a smaller viewport would break legibility.
